rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:819582966F2B00000000}May I have a moment?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296702B00000000}Azuves, did you need me?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296712B00000000}There is something I wish to discuss.
Would you hear me out?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296722B00000000}You want to discuss something with me?
Wouldn't Dad and the others
be better people to ask?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296732B00000000}Forgive me for saying so,
but although he is your father,
I have only known him a short while.

{C:81958296742B00000000}As someone who has fought beside you,
it is only natural that I should trust you
more than I do your father.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296752B00000000}...Azuves,
thank you!
What did you want to discuss?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296762B00000000}The truth is... Few people know this,
but Jojo
is not my grandson.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296772B00000000}He's not your real grandson...?
Then...

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296782B00000000}His real name is Joldy.
{C:819782830400}Joldy Vorder{C:819782830000},
and he is the late King Vorder's son.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296792B00000000}Does that mean
Jojo's a prince?

{C:819582967A2B00000000}Oh, so that's why you told him
not to overestimate his strength,
and that strength alone wasn't enough.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582967B2B00000000}Precisely!
A king needs great strength,
but that alone will not suffice.

{C:819582967C2B00000000}I wanted our prince
to learn that through his own experience.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967D2B00000000}I'm sure Jojo
understands how you feel,
Azuves.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582967F2B00000000}Then let me ask you this.
Do you believe Jojo has grown?
That he has the makings of a king?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802B00000000}Are you sure you should leave
such an important judgment to me?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296812B00000000}It is precisely because it is you
that I ask.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822B00000000}All right.
But honestly, I don't really know
what makes someone fit to be a king.

{C:81958296832B00000000}Watching Jojo work so hard,
I've felt I ought to learn from him.

{C:81958296842B00000000}So if Jojo were king,
I'd like to live in his country.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296852B00000000}Now I can finally
tell our prince the truth.



{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872B00000000}So Jojo would be king...
It won't be easy for him, though.
He's such a nice guy...




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296882B00000000}Jojo, we must talk.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296892B00000000}What's wrong, Grandpa?
You look so serious.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582968A2B00000000}I have watched all your battles
since you first boarded Galient.

{C:819582968B2B00000000}Through countless battles against Mardoul,
Posaydal and Grados,
you have grown.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582968C2B00000000}Grandpa!
Do you really think so?

{C:81900E01}{C:819582968E2B00000000}I do.
That is why I must
tell you the truth.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582968F2B00000000}The truth?
What do you mean?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296902B00000000}Your real name is
Joldy Vorder.
You are the son of the late King Vorder.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296922B00000000}You mean I'm a prince?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296932B00000000}Now is the time for you, as king,
to rise against Mardoul for everyone's sake.
You have gained the strength to do so.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296942B00000000}But Grandpa,
I... I...


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296952B00000000}Do you believe
I was too hasty?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296972B00000000}Now that we're back in Crescent,
I think this is the best time.

{C:81958296982B00000000}But Jojo's kind.
I think he's afraid
of dragging everyone into a war.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296992B00000000}Would you be so kind
as to hear him out again?

{C:81930100}{C:819582969A2B00000000}All right.
I'll find Jojo and talk to him.
But don't get your hopes up.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582969C2B00000000}I can safely
leave it to you.

{C:81900200}{C:819582969D2B00000000}Um...

{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2B00000000}Whoa, Lun, you were here too?
What's wrong?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A02B00000000}I overheard...
Azuves,
may I go with him?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296A12B00000000}You, young lady?
I see no reason why not.
I am counting on you both.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296CE0100000000}Welcome baaack!
Huh? Where's Jojo?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22B00000000}Well, it's a bit complicated.
If you see Jojo,
will you tell him I'm looking for him?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296CF0100000000}Sure, I can do that.
Sooo, is the girl with you
your girlfriend?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A42B00000000}I'm Lun Forest.
Am I his girlfriend, I wonder?


{C:81930100}{C:81958296A62B00000000}Ahh, I was
in the middle of looking for Jojo.
Now, where could he be?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296A82B00000000}Hee hee... Sorry!
I won't tease you anymore, so wait for me!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190D701}{C:81958296A92B00000000}Oh, Wufei,
you're as cold as ever.

{C:81958296AA2B00000000}You won't help me,
so I'm going around
all these places on my own.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296AB2B00000000}That has nothing to do with me.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AC2B00000000}Yes, yes...

{C:81958296AD2B00000000}Oh, you're here too.
Here, this is for you today.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296AE2B00000000}I'm sorry.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296AF2B00000000}Oh? When someone gives you something,
you say thank you, don't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B02B00000000}Oh, you're right.
Thank you.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296B12B00000000}What are you doing?

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296B22B00000000}I'm collecting items
to give you all
an advantage in battle.

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296B32B00000000}I didn't ask you to.

{C:8190D701}{C:81958296B42B00000000}I know.
I'm doing it of my own accord,
so don't let it bother you.

{C:81958296B52B00000000}Now, I'd better go
and find some more presents.
See you again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B62B00000000}Oh, Wufei,
have you seen Jojo?

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296B72B00000000}I wouldn't know.


{C:81900200}{C:81958296B92B00000000}Hee hee.
Wufei almost looks
jealous.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BA2B00000000}Wufei?
No way.
Not Wufei.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296BB2B00000000}Hmm, are you sure?




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:81958296BD2B00000000}To think I was a prince...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE2B00000000}Was it a shock?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296BF2B00000000}What are you two doing here?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02B00000000}Azuves asked us
to see how you were doing.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296C12B00000000}I'm just tagging along.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C32B00000000}What do you think
about me being a prince?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C42B00000000}I don't think it matters
whether you're a prince
or how much power you have.

{C:81958296C52B00000000}What matters is what you want to do
as someone from Crescent.
What do you think?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C62B00000000}As someone from Crescent...

{C:81900200}{C:81958296C82B00000000}Even if you're a prince,
you're still Jojo, right?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C92B00000000}Of course...!
Oh, so that's what it means.
I get it!

{C:81958296CA2B00000000}Yeah, I'll do it.
I may be a prince,
but first, I'm someone from Crescent!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296CB2B00000000}You can do it!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296CC2B00000000}Yeah!

{C:81958296CD2B00000000}All right, now that's settled,
I'd better go
and tell Grandpa!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DA0000000000}Where have you been?
Something amazing's happened.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296D22B00000000}What happened, Sho?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DB0000000000}It turns out
Jojo was a prince.
Quite a shock, eh, Daba?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296D32B00000000}...A prince...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D42B00000000}What's wrong, Daba?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296D52B00000000}Oh, no, it's nothing.

{C:81958296D62B00000000}Hey, Sho.
Do you think it's better
to reveal who you really are?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DC0000000000}Why not?
It's not as if we're friends because of our status.
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D72B00000000}Of course.


{C:81901B00}{C:81958296D82B00000000}That's right!
Otherwise, a Mi Ferario like me
wouldn't be one of you!

{C:81901801}{C:81958296D92B00000000}Excuse me.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296DA2B00000000}Oh, I'm sorry.

{C:81901801}{C:81958296DB2B00000000}Prince Joldy,
I am {C:819782830400}Zuwel{C:819782830000}'s pilot,
{C:819782830400}Jilmzen Ranvel.{C:819782830000}

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296D00100000000}Ranvel's been fighting for us
at White Valley
the whole time you were away, Jojo.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296DC2B00000000}So that's what happened.
Thank you, Ranvel!

{C:81901801}{C:81958296DD2B00000000}Even though I did not know you were a prince,
please forgive my discourtesy.

{C:81958296DE2B00000000}And at the risk of further discourtesy,
I have a request.
May I join your ranks?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296DF2B00000000}Of course.
In fact, I should be
asking you to join us.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901801}{C:81958296E02B00000000}Thank you.
But are you certain
you should trust me so easily?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296E22B00000000}It's all right.
Our leader
is that kind of person too.

{C:81905400}{C:81958296E32B00000000}Our leader?
Daba, who could he mean?

{C:81905300}{C:81958296E42B00000000}Isn't it obvious?
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E52B00000000}Did we
have a leader?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DD0000000000}Ha ha ha ha ha!
That's our leader for you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E62B00000000}Huh?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296E82B00000000}They're all talking about you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E92B00000000}Whaaat, me?!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296EA2B00000000}It's because he's like this
that everyone follows him.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296DE0000000000}That's right.
But don't start acting self-conscious.
We all like you just as you are.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EB2B00000000}Right...

{C:81900200}{C:81958296EE2B00000000}Cheer up!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EF2B00000000}But it's all
so sudden...

{C:81900200}{C:81958296F02B00000000}It's all right.
Have confidence in yourself.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296F32B00000000}Sigh... Me, the leader?
I can't believe
everyone sees me that way.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F42B00000000}What's wrong?
You're muttering to yourself.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F52B00000000}Nelfea,
who do you think
is leading our group right now?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F62B00000000}Whaaaaaat?
Why are you asking that now?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296F82B00000000}Sho and Daba told him,
"You're our leader!"
But he doesn't seem to believe it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F92B00000000}Well, of course I don't.
There are so many people
more impressive than me.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FA2B00000000}That's true.
Even I'm
a better pilot than you.

{C:81900200}{C:81958296FC2B00000000}Um...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FD2B00000000}But people don't follow someone
just because
they're more or less skilled.

{C:81958296FE2B00000000}Even Rie follows you,
despite being the captain,
and it's not because she's your sister.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FF2B00000000}Huh?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296002C00000000}It's because she's obsessed with her brother...

{C:81958296012C00000000}I'm joking.
It's because she believes in you.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296022C00000000}Who are you calling obsessed with her brother?!!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296032C00000000}Oh my, you were here?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296042C00000000}Yes, I was!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296052C00000000}Then there's no need to ask, is there?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296062C00000000}Hey, you two.
That's enough.



{x00}

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296072C00000000}Wooo, wooo!
It's an alaaaarm!
The enemy's coming!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296092C00000000}But there isn't even an alarm going off.

{C:8190A702}{C:819582960A2C00000000}I'm a ninja,
so my eyesight's super good!


{x00}

{C:81900600}{C:819582960C2C00000000}Oh, that was quick.
You seem well trained.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960D2C00000000}Never mind that. What about the enemy?!

{C:81908400}{C:819582960E2C00000000}They seem to be aboard an old Terra warship, 
{C:819782830400}Zanzibar{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960F2C00000000}Astante II, launch!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296102C00000000}Yes!
Astante II is launching!

rows.en:
{C:81930A01}{C:81958296142C00000000}Under the circumstances, we'd better attack the 
{C:819782830300}Iron Castle{C:819782830000} as soon
as possible.

{C:81932201}{C:81958296162C00000000}I think we should
if we're to move forward.
What do you think?

{C:81930600}{C:81958296172C00000000}That's a sound judgment.
What do you say?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296182C00000000}Let's go, Jojo!
The first strike wins.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901701}{C:81958296D10100000000}Your Majesty, please wait!
There is no need for Your Majesty
to face the likes of them in person!

{C:81901601}{C:81958296222C00000000}High... You see,
I want to witness
their strength with my own eyes.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D20100000000}But Your Majesty...

{C:81901601}{C:81958296232C00000000}Very well, then.
You may go first.

{C:81958296242C00000000}But if you are no match for them,
I shall go out myself.
Is that understood, High?

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D30100000000}Even if it costs me my life,
I promise you
I will sink the Astante II.



{x00}

{C:81900A01}{C:819582962B2C00000000}I could go by myself.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C2C00000000}No way.
It would be dangerous
for you to go alone.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582962D2C00000000}Maybe so,
but I know it's dangerous.
That's why I want fewer people to go.

{C:81901C00}{C:819582962E2C00000000}Hee hee. Haven't we heard
something like that before?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962F2C00000000}Have we?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296DF0000000000}It's remarkably similar
to what you once said.
Have you forgotten?


{C:8190D301}{C:81958296302C00000000}Excuse me.

{C:81958296312C00000000}I've been told Heero Yuy
is here.
May I see him?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296E00000000000}I'll show you the way.

{C:81900C01}{C:81958296322C00000000}Hey, that's not a good idea.
You can't just take a stranger in.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296E20000000000}I know her.
Don't worry about it.


{x00}

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582963D2C00000000}There he is! Mardoul!

{C:81930100}{C:819582963E2C00000000}So that's Mardoul...


{C:81901601}{C:819582963F2C00000000}Prince Joldy,
do you know what this place is?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296402C00000000}It's a Panzer Blade excavation site.
Anyone could see that!

{C:81901601}{C:81958296412C00000000}I needed
to excavate Panzer Blades
for a certain purpose.

{C:81958296422C00000000}But this continent's technology is still primitive.
So I accepted a proposal
from a young person from Claudia.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296432C00000000}Your purpose... You joined forces
to conquer Crescent, didn't you?!

{C:81901601}{C:81958296442C00000000}That is not my purpose.
I wish to end this unrelated war
as soon as possible.

{C:81958296452C00000000}I am even considering a truce
and lending you my strength to that end.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296462C00000000}How are we supposed to believe
what you're saying?
You were our enemy until now.


{C:81901601}{C:81958296472C00000000}Boy from another continent,
you are right.
But it is still too early to speak of it.

{C:81958296482C00000000}...High Schultatte.
You are there, are you not?
Come out.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D70100000000}I am always at Your Majesty's side.

{C:81901601}{C:81958296492C00000000}High commands my Royal Guard.
I shall send him
to fight alongside you.

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D80100000000}Your Majesty?!

{C:81901601}{C:819582964A2C00000000}My beloved High,
will you not grant my request?

{C:81901701}{C:81958296D90100000000}...If that is Your Majesty's wish.

{C:81901601}{C:819582964B2C00000000}Well, Prince Joldy,
and boy from another continent,
is even this not enough?


{C:81900A01}{C:819582964C2C00000000}I'd ask what you think...
but I can already imagine the answer.


{C:81930100}{C:819582964D2C00000000}Yeah, yeah, I'm simple-minded.

{C:81900A01}{C:819582964E2C00000000}I'm complimenting you.

{C:81958296502C00000000}Mardoul, I accept the truce.
But only until the war outside is over.

{C:81901601}{C:81958296512C00000000}I understand.
When this war is over,
then we shall settle who is stronger.

{C:81958296522C00000000}Now, go.
The Cloud Sea will open soon.






{x00}

{C:8190EE01}{C:81958296642C00000000}I am {C:819782830400}Lady Une{C:819782830000}
and I have come to convey the words
of His Excellency Treize Khushrenada:

{C:81958296652C00000000}"To investigate the enemy's movements
and find people who might become our allies,
I must oppose you for a time.

{C:81958296662C00000000}I have sent Lady, whom I trust,
because I want you to know
that those actions are not my true intent."

{C:81958296672C00000000}That is his message.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296BF3A00000000}Oh? You seem to be keeping on top of things.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296752C00000000}There's a girl who's always on my case.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967C2C00000000}Phew, it's finally done.
I just can't leave Cloud Saber's maintenance
to anyone else.

{C:81900700}{C:819582967D2C00000000}That's the right attitude.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967E2C00000000}Oh, Professor.
What brings you here?


{C:81900700}{C:819582967F2C00000000}Well, I came to see how Cloud Saber was doing
and whether you'd talked about the FTs.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296802C00000000}Oh, yes, we've talked about them.
We have companions who suit the machines' capabilities,
so I'm having them try them out.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296812C00000000}I see...
Pilots who can handle FTs
must be exceptionally capable.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296822C00000000}And they're good people too.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296832C00000000}Good companions are a precious treasure.
Be sure to value them.


{C:81930100}{C:81958296842C00000000}Now then, I wonder if Jojo's back.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296862C00000000}By the way, the next continent we can reach is 
{C:819782830300}Brave{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296872C00000000}I was just about to ask.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296882C00000000}The first strike wins!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296892C00000000}(I wonder how Mikoto's doing.)

{C:81909202}{C:819582968A2C00000000}Heh heh, Guy,
you're thinking
about Mikoto, aren't you?

{C:81905401}{C:819582968B2C00000000}Yeah.

the friends we left behind.

{C:81902201}{C:819582968C2C00000000}Could you launch, please?

{C:81939200}{C:81958296902C00000000}{C:819782830400}Crinn{C:819782830000}'s right.

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296912C00000000}I picked you up in the Cloud Sea,

{C:81958296962C00000000}You are forbidden to return to Grados.
Do you understand? Until you hear from me,
